title: RFID Ear Tag Livestock — USDA APHIS ADT / EU 2019/2035 / ISO 11784-11785 / ICAR / NLIS Animal Identification RFID
summary: RFID livestock ear tags apply a GS1 / ICAR / national-animal-ID-scheme identifier to every cattle, sheep, goat, pig, buffalo, bison, cervid and camelid premises-of-birth animal and bind mill heat, two-piece applicator lot, ear-notch / genomic-parentage DNA sample, vaccination history, USDA APHIS ADT / EU 2019/2035 / EU 2021/1372 / EU 1760/2000 / NLIS / NAIT / CFIA compliance and slaughter traceability to the serial so auction-ring / feedlot / dairy-parlor / veterinary-chute / slaughter-plant / border-crossing inspectors surface the record with a LF ISO 11784/11785 HDX / FDX-B transceiver or a UHF RAIN portal — publishing EPCIS 2.0 ObjectEvents to national traceability databases (USDA APHIS ADT / TRACES / NLIS / NAIT / SIGAP / SNIIM) and FSIS / EFSA / Codex Alimentarius / OIE / WOAH food-safety systems and feeding into CattleMax / Cattlytics / MiHub / ALLFLEX SenseHub / NEDAP CowControl / DairyComp 305 / FeedlotWise / MicroBeef herd-management platforms instead of paint-brand + hot-iron + tattoo + paper breeding-book records.
keywords: ICAR Section 5 cattle + Section 10 sheep / goats
NLIS Australia + NAIT New Zealand animal traceability
heroPoints: USDA APHIS ADT 9 CFR Part 86 + EU 2019/2035 + EU 1760/2000 + EU 2021/1372 + NLIS + NAIT + CFIA animal traceability-fit per-animal identifier — every beef-cattle, dairy-cow, feeder-calf, sheep, goat, pig, bison, cervid, buffalo and camelid carries an ISO 11784/11785 FDX-B or HDX 15-digit country + species + unique-ID record binding premises-of-birth PIN / FEI, ear-notch / tail-hair genomic-parentage DNA, vaccination lot (RB51 brucellosis / BCG / FMD / CSF / BVD / IBR / BRSV / Clostridium / CDT / CAE / scrapie), treatment history (ionophore / coccidiostat / antibiotic withdrawal period) and USDA PVP / SVP / BSE HC source-verification to the fastener serial.

LF ISO 11784/11785 HDX / FDX-B + UHF RAIN Gen2v2 dual-frequency architecture — LF (134.2 kHz) handheld / panel reads satisfy USDA APHIS ADT + EU 2019/2035 + NLIS + NAIT regulatory presentation at auction ring / border-crossing / slaughter kill-floor; UHF (860-960 MHz) portal reads enable feedlot bunk / dairy-parlor sort-gate / weigh-scale / squeeze-chute / pour-on race 600-1,000+ animals-per-hour throughput — both frequencies produced as EPCIS 2.0 ObjectEvents published to USDA APHIS Animal Disease Traceability Information System (ADTIS) / USDA-ARS Livestock Information Service (LIS) / TRACES NT / NLIS Database / NAIT Database / CFIA CLTS instead of paper ASV / VSI / health certificates.

Two-piece TPU / Santoprene ear tag applied with Allflex Universal Total Tagger / Y-TEX Advance Lockout / Datamars Tagger / Ritchey Easy-Tagger applicator — male stud + female button locked in under 3 seconds with ICAR Section 5 / 10-audited 97-99 % 12-month retention rate, UV-stabilised to ASTM G154 QUV 3,000 h, cold-cracking -40 °C per ASTM D2137, resistant to EU 1282/2011 pour-on avermectin / organophosphate dip-vat / chlorhexidine / iodine teat-dip / PaaCO₂ footbath chemistry, and survives 5-7 year extensive-grazing / rangeland / Patagonian / Sahel / Himalayan / boreal-forest deployment.

brief.label: Chip options
brief.text: LF (134.2 kHz) ISO 11784/11785 FDX-B (full-duplex) — the USDA APHIS ADT 840-series + EU 1760/2000 country-code + NLIS + NAIT regulatory baseline, supplied via EM Microelectronic EM4305 / EM4469 / EM4569 or Sokymat / Hitag-S; LF ISO 11784/11785 HDX (half-duplex) — Texas Instruments (TIRIS) / Destron Fearing / Allflex half-duplex variant for wet / noisy-EMI environments; UHF RAIN Gen2v2 — Impinj Monza R6-P / M750 / M770 / M775 for long-range feedlot / dairy-parlor / auction-ring portals, NXP UCODE 9 / 9xe for extended user-memory carrying birth-date / breed-code / owner-ID / treatment history on the tag for disconnected reads at remote ranch / station / shieling, Alien Higgs-9 for densely-populated calf-bunk / sheep-race clusters; dual-frequency operation for combined regulatory + operational Tier-1 programmes — note EM Microelectronic EM4423 is HF + UHF (ISO 14443A 13.56 MHz NFC + EPC Gen2 UHF, NOT LF 134.2 kHz per EM4423 datasheet); for true LF + UHF combining ISO 11784/11785 regulatory compliance with UHF operational reads, specify a stacked LF + UHF inlay (separate LF + UHF dies bonded together); NTAG424 DNA (13.56 MHz HF) with SUN CMAC AES-128 per-tap signature per NXP AN12196 for high-value registered-breeding-stock, rare-breed conservation herd, FEI equine / UCI endurance, Wagyu A5 / Kobe / Chianina / Limousin pedigree-bull, and any programme where per-tap cryptographic signing against the national-animal-ID register is required.

brief.label: Frequency / air interface
brief.text: 134.2 kHz LF per ISO 11784:1996 (code structure) + ISO 11785:1996 (technical concept) + ISO 24631-1 to 24631-7:2017 conformance / performance / consistency testing for USDA APHIS ADT + EU 1760/2000 + EU 2019/2035 + NLIS + NAIT + CFIA + SIGAP + SNIIM regulatory read; 860-960 MHz UHF Gen2v2 per EPCglobal Class 1 Gen 2 v2.1 + ISO/IEC 18000-63:2015 for feedlot / dairy-parlor / sort-gate / squeeze-chute / weigh-scale / auction-ring portal reads; 13.56 MHz HF per ISO/IEC 14443-3 Type A + NFC Forum Type 4 Tag Operation v3.0 for NTAG424 DNA veterinary-chute per-animal forensic tap; FCC Part 15 / ETSI EN 300 330 (LF) + ETSI EN 302 208 (UHF) / IC RSS-210 + RSS-247 spectrum compliance; ATEX / IECEx Zone 2 reader stack for grain-dust feed-mill / ethanol co-product distillers-grain plants; weather-sealed IP67 portal enclosures for outdoor auction-ring / border-crossing deployment.

brief.label: Animal identifier scheme
brief.text: Per-animal ISO 11784 15-digit national-animal-ID scheme carrying ICAR manufacturer code (3 digits), country code (3 digits per ISO 3166 numeric), species code (1 digit: 1=sheep, 2=cattle, 3=goat, 4=pig, 5=equine, 6=canine, 7=feline, 8=bird, 9=other) and unique-ID (9 digits + USDA 840-series prefix for US), with upper-layer binding to USDA APHIS ADT premises PIN (7-digit State + 3-digit premises), EU 1760/2000 cattle passport CHN (14-digit herd identifier + individual), NLIS RFID device number (16 digits including PIC), NAIT NAIT-number (8 digits) and ICAR-audited manufacturer. UHF layer publishes a parallel GS1 GIAI-96 per GS1 Tag Data Standard 2.0 §7.1 carrying birth-date (YYYY-MM-DD), breed-code (ICAR 3-letter: ANG / HER / HOL / JER / CHA / LIM / SIM / BRH / BRM / BRD / WAG / SHO), sire-dam CHN / USDA 840, owner PIN, management group (heifer / steer / bull / cow / calf / wether / ram / ewe / barrow / gilt / sow / boar), vaccination lot (RB51 brucellosis / FMD / CSF / BVD / IBR / BRSV / Clostridium 7-way / CDT / BCG / scrapie / CAE), treatment history with withdrawal-period per FDA 21 CFR 556 + EMA CVMP MRL, genomic-parentage SNP panel ID (Zoetis GeneSeek GGP / Neogen Igenity / Weatherbys GeneSeek), body-condition score (BCS 1-9 for beef / 1-5 for dairy), weaning / yearling / pre-harvest weight + ADG, and USDA PVP / SVP / BSE HC / MPP-Dairy source-verification. Events publish as EPCIS 2.0 ObjectEvents with bizStep=tagging / weighing / vaccinating / treating / weaning / shipping / slaughtering / retiring with disposition keyed to custody state (on-premises / in-transit / in-feedlot / in-slaughter / deceased / recalled / retired).

brief.label: Form-factor SKUs (6)
brief.text: (1) Two-piece button + stud 31 × 28 mm LF (134.2 kHz FDX-B / HDX): Allflex Ultra / Y-TEX AA Tag / Datamars Z-Tag / Ritchey CalfSet-compatible ICAR-approved USDA APHIS 840-series for cattle / bison / buffalo / cervid; (2) Two-piece button + stud 25 × 22 mm LF: ICAR-approved for sheep / goats / camelid / alpaca at smaller ear size; (3) Dual-frequency LF + UHF hybrid tag: stacked inlay carrying ISO 11784 FDX-B + GS1 GIAI-96 for combined regulatory + feedlot / dairy-parlor operational read; (4) UHF-only 45 × 35 mm button: Impinj Monza R6-P / M750 / NXP UCODE 9 for feedlot / dairy / auction-ring operational throughput where LF regulatory tag is secondary; (5) Rumen / abomasal bolus 70 × 20 mm ceramic LF: swallowed rumen bolus for cattle / sheep / goat permanent retention per ICAR Section 11.7 bolus testing; (6) Injectable glass transponder 12 × 2 mm LF ISO 11784/11785: registered breeding-stock / rare-breed / equine FEI / UCI / racing greyhound / zoo wildlife / aquaculture broodstock per ISO 24631-7 injectable performance standard.

brief.label: Housing material & retention qualification
brief.text: TPU (thermoplastic polyurethane 92A-95A Shore hardness) + Santoprene TPV for primary tag body — UV-stabilised to ASTM G154 QUV 3,000 h; cold-cracking -40 °C per ASTM D2137 for Patagonian / Siberian / Canadian prairie / Tibetan plateau deployment; tear strength > 90 N per ASTM D624 Die C; tensile > 30 MPa per ASTM D412; UL 94 HB; RoHS + REACH compliant; ICAR Section 5.5 (cattle) + Section 10.6 (sheep-goat) 12-month retention testing 97-99 % minimum; USDA APHIS ADT 840-series approved supplier tag stock; Allflex Universal Total Tagger / Y-TEX Advance Lockout / Datamars / Ritchey Easy-Tagger applicator compatible without specialised tools. Male stud: hardened acetal POM or polycarbonate locking tip per ICAR Section 5.5.2 applicator-force profile; female button: laser-printed visual-ID number on both faces per USDA APHIS 9 CFR §86.4 human-readable + machine-readable dual-presentation; EID chip potted in epoxy / polyurethane cavity resistant to EU 1282/2011 ectoparasiticide pour-on (ivermectin / eprinomectin / moxidectin / amitraz / pyrethroid) and EU 2021/1372 chlorhexidine / iodine teat-dip / cypermethrin sheep-dip / organophosphate backline chemistry.

brief.label: Environmental qualification
brief.text: IP67 + IP68 tag housing; -40 °C to +80 °C operating; -50 °C to +85 °C storage; UV exposure ASTM G154 QUV 3,000 h; salt-spray ASTM B117 1,000 h for coastal / marine-climate New Zealand / Ireland / Wales / Patagonia / Falkland grazing; chemical resistance to MAFAC / DIVERSEY / Ecolab teat-dip, Cydectin / Ivomec / Dectomax pour-on, CIDR / PRID / CueMate progesterone inserts (without interfering with chip read); resistant to manure / slurry / silage effluent / UV-sun-bleach / hot-iron-branding-adjacent / freeze-brand nitrogen splash; ICAR Section 5.5 (cattle) + Section 10.6 (sheep-goat) + Section 11.7 (rumen bolus) + Section 5.6 (injectable) retention and performance testing; ISO 24631-3 in-vivo performance + ISO 24631-5 consistency testing passed; functional at dusty / pollen-laden / fly-strike / hot-branded / dehorn-cautery-adjacent application site.

brief.label: Read range (feedlot / dairy / auction / rangeland)
brief.text: LF (134.2 kHz) 10-30 cm from Allflex AWR250 / Tru-Test XRS2i / Z-Tag reader + panel reader race-length coverage; UHF (860-960 MHz) 3-8 m from Zebra FX9600 / FX7500 fixed reader + Chainway C72 / CS108 handheld; dual-frequency tag read at both LF regulatory range + UHF operational range simultaneously; portal read-rate 99 %+ at feedlot alley / dairy sort-gate / auction ring walk-through; 600-1,000+ animals-per-hour UHF portal throughput vs 200-400 animals-per-hour LF single-file chute throughput; rumen bolus read range 15-25 cm at handheld neck-wand; injectable chip read range 8-15 cm at handheld wand per ISO 24631-5 performance. HF NTAG424 DNA read range 2-5 cm per ISO/IEC 14443-3 Type A for forensic per-animal tap at veterinary chute.

brief.label: Cryptographic posture
brief.text: For USDA APHIS ADT + EU 2019/2035 + NLIS + NAIT + CFIA + SIGAP + SNIIM regulatory baseline: ISO 11784/11785 FDX-B / HDX — unique-read-only 15-digit national-animal-ID with manufacturer authorisation via ICAR device-registration. For UHF operational layer: NXP UCODE 9 / 9xe user-memory permalock + password-protected access + TID serialisation; Impinj Monza R6-P 96-bit EPC + 32-bit TID access-password; Alien Higgs-9 {chip:alien-higgs-9:user_bits}-bit user-memory kill-password. For Tier-1 registered-breeding / rare-breed / equine FEI / UCI / racing-greyhound / zoo-wildlife / aquaculture-broodstock programmes: NTAG424 DNA SUN CMAC AES-128 per-tap signature per NXP AN12196 with the national-animal-ID register as cryptographic anchor — every veterinary-chute / show-ring / blood-draw / embryo-transfer / semen-collection / slaughter-plant tap publishes a tamper-evident signed event that survives EU 2017/625 Official Controls Regulation + USDA FSIS 9 CFR 310 ante-mortem / post-mortem inspection + OIE WOAH Terrestrial Animal Health Code + Codex Alimentarius CAC/RCP 58-2005 meat-hygiene chain of custody.

sections.title: Regulatory & interoperability baseline at a glance
bullets: Any USDA APHIS ADT / EU 2019/2035 / EU 1760/2000 / NLIS / NAIT / CFIA CLTS programme presumes 15-digit ISO 11784 FDX-B / HDX compliance — paint-brand + hot-iron + tattoo + paper breeding-book records no longer satisfy interstate / intra-Community / export-certificate audit; the DEEP tag carries the 15-digit national-animal-ID in the LF layer and a parallel GS1 GIAI-96 in the UHF layer for operational reads at feedlot bunk / dairy parlor / sort gate / weigh scale / auction ring.

ICAR Section 5.5 (cattle) + Section 10.6 (sheep-goat) + Section 11.7 (rumen bolus) + Section 5.6 (injectable) retention-and-performance testing is the international-trade interoperability gate — Allflex / Y-TEX / Datamars / Ritchey / Destron Fearing approved-supplier tag stock carries ICAR device-register IDs that regulators cross-check when accepting foreign-origin animals under OIE WOAH + EU TRACES NT + CFIA CLTS.

UHF RAIN portal reads do not replace LF regulatory reads — they layer on top. A feedlot running 25,000 head through a bunk-line UHF portal every feeding still needs LF handheld at the squeeze chute for health treatment + LF panel at the weigh scale for pre-shipment NLIS submission; the dual-frequency SKU is the operational sweet spot for programmes above 1,000 head.

NTAG424 DNA SUN CMAC AES-128 per-tap signing layers cryptographic authenticity onto the regulatory ID — useful for registered-breeding-stock (Wagyu / Kobe / Chianina / Limousin / Angus pedigree bulls), equine FEI passport, UCI endurance horses, racing greyhounds, zoo-wildlife conservation herds, and any programme where a regulator or buyer needs tamper-evident proof of identity at the point of tap.

Genomic parentage (Zoetis GeneSeek GGP / Neogen Igenity / Weatherbys GeneSeek SNP panel) cross-validates the EID — an ear tag can fall out but a DNA profile cannot; the DEEP record binds the SNP panel ID to the ISO 11784 number so retagging or tag loss does not break traceability chain.

sections.title: Paper breeding book + hot-iron brand vs DEEP dual-frequency livestock EID
bullets: The before-state assumes visual ear tag reading in dusty corrals and handwritten breeding-book records; it fails the moment USDA APHIS ADT interstate-movement inspection asks for birth-premises PIN + vaccination lot on a 2,000-head feeder lot moving across state lines — or NLIS Australia asks for PIC + RFID device number for slaughter receival.

The after-state binds LF ISO 11784 FDX-B (regulatory) + UHF GS1 GIAI-96 (operational) + optional NTAG424 DNA (cryptographic) to a single two-piece ear tag. Every animal carries its own premises-of-birth PIN, genomic-parentage SNP, vaccination lot, treatment history, weight + ADG curve, BCS, owner transfers, auction-ring sale record, slaughter-plant FSIS PHIS lot, and EPCIS 2.0 event trail.

In practice, integrators pair the DEEP tag with CattleMax / ALLFLEX SenseHub / NEDAP CowControl / DairyComp 305 / FeedlotWise / MicroBeef so veterinary-chute taps, squeeze-chute weigh events, sort-gate sorts, dairy parlor milk-yield reads, and feedlot bunk reads land in the same event log as USDA APHIS ADTIS + EU TRACES + NLIS + NAIT + CFIA submissions — with SPC chart + Shewhart control limit + ADG regression against Zoetis GeneSeek GGP genomic-EBV expectations.

The rumen bolus + injectable SKUs cover edge cases where ear-tag retention is marginal (Merino sheep with small ears, rodeo bulls that shed tags under stress, registered Wagyu breeding stock where tag loss is commercially catastrophic) — both bolus and injectable use the same ISO 11784 15-digit scheme so the regulatory read experience is identical to the ear tag.

sections.title: Buyer-side playbook — beef / dairy / sheep / goat / feedlot / auction
bullets: Tier-1 dual-frequency LF + UHF deployment — feedlot operators running 10,000-100,000+ head at single-location capacity-utilised bunk lines fit every animal with LF + UHF stacked ear tag at arrival processing; LF handheld supports squeeze-chute treatments for BRD / pneumonia + implants + pour-on, UHF portal captures bunk-line visits + water-station visits + sort-gate sorts + weigh-scale events at 600-1,000+ animals-per-hour throughput.

Dairy parlor integration — DeLaval DelPro / GEA CowScout / BouMatic MPC / Lely Horizon / AfiFarm / NEDAP CowControl reads the LF tag at the milking stall for per-cow milk-yield + conductivity + rumination + heat-detection; UHF portal at the sort-gate pushes high-SCC / low-yield / fresh-cow / dry-off candidates to the handler alley; NTAG424 DNA tap at the veterinary chute for mastitis culture + metritis + DA surgery + foot-trim event logging.

Sheep + goat rangeland ICAR Section 10 deployment — Australian / New Zealand / Patagonian / Welsh hill / Sahel / Atlas / Tibetan plateau extensive-grazing operations fit all lambs / kids at marking with 25 × 22 mm small-ruminant ear tag; LF handheld at the drafting race + yard-weigh scale + shearing shed + footbath supports FAMACHA scoring + BCS + fleece weight + micron + crimp + lambing percentage + scanner ultrasound recording.

Auction-ring + saleyard operations — 500-2,000 head per sale day walk-through UHF portal at the ring entry auto-records buyer-seller + weight + lot number; LF handheld at the settlement office for NLIS PIC-to-PIC transfer submission + USDA APHIS ADT interstate certificate of veterinary inspection (CVI) generation.

Registered-breeding / show-ring / export-certified Tier-1 — pedigree bull stud / dairy elite genomic-tested bull / Wagyu A5 fullblood / rare-breed conservation herd / equine FEI / UCI endurance horse / zoo-wildlife conservation programme layers NTAG424 DNA SUN CMAC AES-128 over the ISO 11784 baseline so every show-ring ring-steward tap, semen-collection visit, embryo-transfer procedure, quarantine-station health-check, border-crossing veterinary inspection and slaughter-plant kill-floor event produces a cryptographically signed EPCIS 2.0 record that survives EU 2017/625 OCR + USDA FSIS PHIS + OIE WOAH + Codex Alimentarius audit.

faq.question: Is the UHF ear tag compatible with USDA APHIS ADT and EU 2019/2035 national traceability programmes?
faq.answer: Not on its own. USDA APHIS ADT 9 CFR Part 86 and EU Regulation 2019/2035 + 1760/2000 (cattle) + 21/2004 (sheep-goats) require a 15-digit ISO 11784 FDX-B or HDX LF (134.2 kHz) identifier that encodes the ICAR manufacturer code + country code + species code + unique ID. A UHF RAIN-only tag does not meet that baseline. The DEEP dual-frequency SKU stacks an LF ISO 11784 FDX-B inlay (for USDA APHIS ADTIS / EU TRACES / NLIS / NAIT / CFIA CLTS regulatory compliance) together with a UHF GS1 GIAI-96 inlay (for feedlot / dairy / auction operational throughput) in a single two-piece ear tag — both frequencies read independently by LF handheld + UHF portal hardware. Supplied pre-programmed with USDA 840-series (US), EU country-code (EU Member States), NLIS PIC + RFID device number (Australia), NAIT location-number (New Zealand) or CFIA CLTS (Canada) ID ranges per country approval.

faq.question: What is the 12-month retention rate under ICAR Section 5.5 and Section 10.6 testing?
faq.answer: ICAR-approved supplier tag stock tested to Section 5.5 (cattle) and Section 10.6 (sheep-goat) 97-99 % 12-month retention when applied correctly through the middle third of the ear with a calibrated Allflex Universal Total Tagger / Y-TEX Advance Lockout / Datamars Tagger / Ritchey Easy-Tagger applicator. Retention is highest when the applicator jaw is sharp and the application site avoids ear veins, cartilage ridges, and the tip / base extremes. For Merino sheep, rodeo bulls, and other breeds where ear-tag retention is marginal, the rumen bolus (ICAR Section 11.7) and injectable glass transponder (ICAR Section 5.6 / ISO 24631-7) SKUs provide permanent retention — the rumen bolus is swallowed and retained in the reticulum for life, and the injectable is inserted subcutaneously at the base of the ear or in the ear scutulum per national-scheme approval.

faq.question: When does NTAG424 DNA SUN CMAC layering over the ISO 11784 baseline make sense?
faq.answer: For Tier-1 registered-breeding-stock (Wagyu / Kobe / Chianina / Limousin / Angus pedigree bulls, dairy elite genomic-tested bulls, Holstein / Jersey elite-cow progeny, rare-breed conservation herds), equine FEI passport + UCI endurance horses, racing greyhounds, zoo-wildlife conservation programmes, and any export-certified animal where a regulator or buyer needs cryptographic proof of identity at the point of tap. The NTAG424 DNA chip generates a per-tap CMAC-over-AES-128 signature per NXP AN12196 that anchors against the national-animal-ID register — a counterfeiter cannot replay a previous tap, clone the chip, or substitute an identically-numbered tag without detection. For commodity beef + dairy + sheep + goat + pig operations, the ISO 11784 FDX-B baseline plus UHF GS1 GIAI-96 operational layer is typically sufficient without NTAG424 DNA.

faq.question: How does the tag interact with pour-on avermectins, dip-vat chemistry, and CIDR / PRID / CueMate progesterone inserts?
faq.answer: The TPU / Santoprene housing is resistant to EU 1282/2011 ectoparasiticide pour-on (ivermectin / eprinomectin / moxidectin / doramectin / amitraz / pyrethroid / fipronil) and EU 2021/1372 chlorhexidine / iodine teat-dip / cypermethrin sheep-dip / organophosphate backline chemistry. Dip-vat OP chemistry is the most aggressive — Santoprene TPV housing variants are recommended for any operation that runs OP dip more than twice per year. CIDR / PRID / CueMate / MGA progesterone inserts are intravaginal and do not contact the ear tag; the chip is unaffected by CIDR chemistry. Hot-iron freeze-brand nitrogen splash at brand-application distance (> 30 cm from the ear tag) is also tolerated; closer proximity can scorch the printed visual-ID number without affecting the EID chip. Bolus + injectable SKUs are fully isolated from topical chemistry exposure.
